arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='ref.py'
lines = open(p).read().split('\n')
# locate the serve method block (lines 158..169, 1-based) and replace
start = None
for idx, ln in enumerate(lines):
    if ln.startswith('    def serve('):
        start = idx
        break
end = start
while end < len(lines) and not (lines[end].strip()=='' and end>start and lines[end+1].strip().startswith('def ')):
    end += 1
    if lines[end].strip().startswith('def refill_after_pop'):
        end += 1
        while end < len(lines) and lines[end].strip() != '':
            end += 1
        break
new = '''    def report_service(self, pkt, i, old_t, q, evicted):
        rank_error = sum(1 for o in self.live.values() if o['rank'] < pkt['rank'])
        lag = pkt['lag']
        for o in self.live.values():
            if o['rank'] < pkt['rank']:
                o['lag'] += 1
        self.log.append([i, "dequeue", old_t, q, pkt['pktid'], pkt['rank'],
                         rank_error, lag, evicted])
'''.split('\n')
lines[start:end] = new[:-1]
txt = '\n'.join(lines)
txt = txt.replace("            insort(self.pifo[q], pkt) if False else None\n", "")
# fix dequeue ordering
old = """                    if self.pifo[q]:
                        evicted = self.refill_after_pop(q)
                        self.serve(q, i, old_t, evicted)
                    else:
                        evicted = self.refill(q)
                        if self.pifo[q]:
                            self.serve(q, i, old_t, evicted)
                        else:
                            self.log.append([i, "dequeue", old_t, q, None, None, 0, 0, evicted])"""
new2 = """                    if self.pifo[q]:
                        pkt = self.pifo[q].pop(0)
                        self.pifo_used[q] -= pkt['length']
                        del self.live[pkt['pktid']]
                        self.policy.post_service(pkt['rank'])
                        evicted = self.refill(q)
                        self.report_service(pkt, i, old_t, q, evicted)
                    else:
                        evicted = self.refill(q)
                        if self.pifo[q]:
                            pkt = self.pifo[q].pop(0)
                            self.pifo_used[q] -= pkt['length']
                            del self.live[pkt['pktid']]
                            self.policy.post_service(pkt['rank'])
                            self.report_service(pkt, i, old_t, q, evicted)
                        else:
                            self.log.append([i, "dequeue", old_t, q, None, None, 0, 0, evicted])"""
assert old in txt, "dequeue block not found"
txt = txt.replace(old, new2)
open(p,'w').write(txt)
EOF
python3 -I -B /workspace/ref.py < /workspace/examples/request.json > /tmp/ref.json && python3 -c "
